title: ICYMI: Zep Vector DB, User Store, LlamaIndex support & more!
summary: Wow, despite the great August weather in California 🌴☀️, we shipped a ton of good stuff 🚀. Here's the run-down in case you missed it.
body_markdown:
Wow, despite the great August weather in California 🌴☀️, we shipped a ton of good stuff 🚀. Here's the run-down in case you missed it:


- We shipped the[Zep Vector Store](https://www.getzep.com/blog/introducing-the-zep-document-vector-store/) . 🔎 Zep is now a single, batteries-included platform for grounding LLM apps with long-term memory.
- We partnered with LangChain to demonstrate building[three foundational LLM apps using TypeScript](https://www.getzep.com/blog/foundations-of-llm-app-development-langchainjs/) 🧱🛠️ (and on the[LangChain blog](https://blog.langchain.dev/zep-x-langsmith-foundations-of-llm-app-development-with-langchain-js-and-zep/) ). The article also offers a great introduction to LangChain's LangSmith observability platform.
- We introduced the[Zep User Store](https://www.getzep.com/blog/introducing-users/) . 🧑🏻‍🚀🧔🏿‍♂️👷‍♀️🦸🏽‍♀️ The new` User` object and its associated` Sessions` provide a powerful way to manage and understand the behavior of individuals using your application.
- We released[support for LlamaIndex](https://gpt-index.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/vector_stores/ZepIndexDemo.html) 🦙❤️ and[collaborated with the LlamaIndex team on a post for their blog](https://twitter.com/jerryjliu0/status/1690018390059225088) .
- FlowiseAI[launched support](https://twitter.com/FlowiseAI/status/1694372350748172682) for Zep's new Vector Store! And LangChain[released support](https://twitter.com/LangChainAI/status/1691868585885626790) for both LangChain Python and LangChain.js!
- And finally, we released support for[Anthropic's Claude family](https://www.getzep.com/blog/announcing-anthropic-llm-support/) of LLM models.


Phew! Can't wait for September! Thanks for your ongoing support!


Written by


**[Daniel Chalef](https://www.getzep.com/blog/author/daniel/)** Founder and CEO, Zep
